# Print checklist

*Generated by `plates.py`. Ticks are preserved when it regenerates -- edit
the boxes, not the part lists.*

**2 of 220 parts printed**, 1668 g of PLA in the whole kit across 20 plates.

Tick a part when it is printed AND you have looked at it. A part that came
off the plate warped or with a bit missing is not printed.
